decisions.reason: As a niche thermal-engineering product close to the firm's core machinery business, it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn after only one year.
A single-tube air cooled condenser fits an established industrial heat-exchanger portfolio, and German machinery firms usually allow such products a longer commercialization period.
Although it appears similar to another condenser launch and could face portfolio overlap, it still sits close to the firm's core competencies and is likely to remain on offer.
A liner for corroded heat exchanger tubes supports the installed base and aftermarket service business, which mature industrial firms typically value highly.
A customized industrial air cooler matches the project-based, customer-specific model common in German machinery manufacturing and is therefore unlikely to be dropped quickly.
Heat exchanger tube end repair inserts are a practical maintenance-oriented complement to the firm's core equipment and likely provide steady aftermarket demand.
